notes: SMB inbound - primarily self-serve; on hosted API in public cloud
Use case: agent-facing chat UI; tool-calling to KB and ticket system; downstream systems expect strict JSON objects
Failure modes: (1) streaming responses produce invalid JSON when naive chunk concat is used; (2) function calls returning payloads that don't match consumer schema (missing required keys)
Customer says: 'Everything works without streaming but streaming is necessary for perceived responsiveness by agents.'
SE observation: split tokens across stream boundaries and naive client reassembly causing parse errors; also model sometimes omits keys if prompt lacks explicit "required" enforcement

Suggested mitigations: client-side robust reassembly (buffering until valid JSON), server-side structured-output with strict schema enforcement, include explicit examples and "required" in system prompt, fallback to non-streaming for critical tool-calls
Security: wants SSO (SAML) for admin and audit logging; no residency constraints currently
Commercial: cost-sensitive, prefers pay-as-you-go hosted API; likely to convert to paid tier if streaming reliability is proven
